d.ko: 시리즈의 원점인 『소닉 더 헤지혹』을 비롯해 『소닉 CD』,『소닉 더 헤지혹 2』, 『소닉 더 헤지혹 3&너클즈』를 수록.
d.en: Experience the collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog in Sonic Origins Plus! With 16 legendary Sonic titles including 12 Game Gear games, new playable characters, modes, challenges, behind the scenes content, and more, this is the definitive way to play these classic games!
d.zh: 本作包含作为索尼克系列原点的《刺猬索尼克》，《索尼克CD》、《刺猬索尼克2》、以及《刺猬索尼克3与纳克鲁斯》。
